chunk_aead.rule: per chunk: AES-256-GCM under the per-blob key (HKDF info binds chunk_size), nonce = 11-byte big-endian chunk index || last-chunk flag (0x01 last, else 0x00), no AAD; ciphertext = concatenated ct||16-byte tag per chunk; every chunk holds chunk_size plaintext bytes except the last (1..chunk_size); an empty blob is one empty last chunk; chunk index <= 2^32

generation.seeds: every key below = SHA-256(<label>); labels are in the generator
generation.tool: go run conformance/registry/generate.go (Go 1.27, standard library only)
generation.warning: TEST KEYS ONLY. HPKE encapsulation is randomized: verify enc/ciphertext, do not regenerate to match.

hybrid_kem.rule: HPKE base mode (RFC 9180), KEM MLKEM768-X25519 (X-Wing, draft-ietf-hpke-pq), HKDF-SHA256, AES-256-GCM

key_wrap.rule: HPKE base mode with the hybrid_kem suite; info = "wendy-registry-wrap-v1" || lp(organization_id) || u8 scope kind (1 deployment_id, 2 app_release_id) || lp(scope id) || lp(key_id) || u8 recipient_kind || lp(recipient) || lp(recipient_key_id); lp = uint16 big-endian length || UTF-8 bytes, a field over 65535 bytes is refused; AAD empty; plaintext = the 32-byte key

per_blob_key.rule: blob_key = HKDF-SHA256(IKM = content key, salt = none, info = UTF-8 of EncryptedBlob.plaintext_digest || u32 big-endian ArtifactManifest.chunk_size, L = 32)

sealed_content_key.rule: AES-256-GCM under the 32-byte deployment key, 12-byte random nonce (SealedContentKey.nonce; fixed here for the vector only); AAD = "wendy-registry-seal-v1" || lp(organization_id) || lp(deployment_id) || lp(manifest_digest) || lp(content_key_id) || lp(deployment_key_id); plaintext = the 32-byte content key
